It tastes DELICIOUS.|audio = Night4Wave13.ogg|[[The Umbra (Narrator)|The Umbra]] dialogue on Wave 13 ([[Totality Tower]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cursed Knight''' was an enemy that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. In [[Tower Outskirts]] it did not appear naturally and was instead spawned by the [[Penumbras]], while in [[Totality Tower]] it appeared naturally and was also spawned by the [[Lunar Servant]]. It was very similar to the [[Knight (Solar Eclipse)|Knight]], but had more health than it. ==Appearance== The '''Cursed Knight''' looked very similar to the [[Knight (Solar Eclipse)|Knight]]. It had dark purple skin and wore dark purple full body armor. It wielded a mace and purple and orange colored shield. While running, it held up a shield in front of it with its left arm. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS are recommended, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]]. **You can use the [[Commander]] to boost the firerate of nearby [[towers]]. *Towers that deal full damage to defense enemies, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or the [[Pursuit]] can be useful against this. **Do note that only explosion damage dealt by the [[Ace Pilot]] and the [[Pursuit]] deal full damage to defense enemies. *You can also use towers that can reduce defense such as the [[Electroshocker]] or the [[Frost Blaster]]. **Additionally, these towers can also slow this enemy down. ==Trivia== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cursed Knight''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Cursed Knight''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in [[Totality Tower]]. **Health increased from 400 to 500. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Cursed Knight''' removed. {{TotalityTower|[[Ghost Knight]]|Wave 12|Cursed Knight|Wave 13|[[Cursed Guard]], [[Flare]] & [[Cursed Horse]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Tower Outskirts]]
